letter.text:
[PRACTICE NAME]
[DATE]

Health Plan Appeals Department

Re: Appeal of Medical Necessity Denial
Member ID: M-62018
Claim number: CLM-88310427
Payer claim number: 26261-004417
Date of service: 2026-09-18
Remit date: 2026-10-09

Appealed line:
Line 2: CPT 97110-GP x3, therapeutic exercise, billed $141.00, denied CO-50

Dear Appeals Department,

We are appealing the denial of Line 2 on the claim above. The service was denied under CO-50 as not medically necessary. The documentation meets the payer's own coverage criteria, so we ask that this line be reprocessed for payment.

Policy DEMO-PT-001, Outpatient physical therapy documentation, states: "Therapeutic exercise (CPT 97110) is medically necessary when a current plan of care documents measurable functional goals and the progress notes show measurable progress toward those goals."

Both conditions are met.

Measurable functional goals: The current plan of care, dated 2026-08-04, sets these goals: "1. Lift 25 lb from floor to waist without increase in pain, to return to warehouse work." and "3. Oswestry Disability Index below 20%."

Measurable progress: The progress note for the date of service documents: "Oswestry Disability Index 26% (42% at evaluation). Lifts 20 lb floor to waist with good mechanics and no pain increase. Sitting tolerance 45 minutes." The assessment states: "Assessment: Measurable progress on all three goals."

Units billed: The note records "Therapeutic exercise 40 minutes (lifting progression, core stabilization)." Policy DEMO-PT-001 allows "three units for 38 to 52 minutes," which supports the three units billed.

The plan of care and the progress note show that therapeutic exercise on 2026-09-18 met the criteria in Policy DEMO-PT-001. We respectfully request that Line 2, CPT 97110-GP x3, billed at $141.00, be overturned and paid.

Please contact our office with any questions.

Sincerely,

[PROVIDER NAME, CREDENTIALS]
[PRACTICE NAME]

Enclosures:
1. Remittance advice dated 2026-10-09
2. Physical therapy plan of care dated 2026-08-04
3. Progress note, visit 14, dated 2026-09-18
